h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Haryana

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Haryana

items.pText: FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for builders, housing societies, schools and municipal parks across Haryana. The state's buyers vary a lot by region. Gurgaon has high-rise projects where the play area sits on a podium or in a landscaped central court. Faridabad has large public parks and older residential sectors. Sonipat, Rohtak, Karnal and Panipat have growing numbers of private schools that want equipment for several age groups.

We build every piece at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, with in-house design, roto-moulding and fabrication. The finished equipment travels to Haryana by road, and our team or a dealer in north India installs it. Before you order, we send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, so the builder, the society committee or the school management can see exactly what goes where. You can approve it or ask for changes before we start manufacturing.

Haryana summers are extremely hot and dusty, and winter brings dense fog. Roto-moulded parts keep their colour in strong sun, and galvanised posts resist rust through the monsoon and the damp winter. Trees on the west side of the play area keep slides cooler on May and June afternoons. Dust collects on slides and decks, so a regular wash keeps them smooth. facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a podium without drilling?
items.a: Yes. Many pieces can be installed self-standing on a prepared base. Share the podium drawings and your engineer's guidance, and we will suggest equipment that suits the slab.

items.q: Do you supply playgrounds for new projects before handover?
items.a: Yes. Builders share the site plan and handover date, and we plan the layout, manufacture at Vasai and install. Tell us your timeline early so dispatch can be planned around it.

items.q: Can we choose colours to match our project?
items.a: Yes. Roto-moulded parts come in 15+ colour shades, and design customisation is available on request. We show the colours on the layout before manufacturing.
